title: The president of the United States awards Musk and tech leaders top science medals; announces $6 billion research initiative
summary: The president of the United States awarded the National Medal of Science to Musk, Brin, Huang, and Su, and the National Medal of Technology to Dell and Nadella. He unveiled $6 billion in new science investments, including $2.4 billion in supercomputing resources from 11 industry partners.
takeaways: Medals awarded to Musk, Brin, Huang, Su, Dell, Nadella
$6 billion total new science investments announced
$2.4 billion supercomputing resources; Nvidia $1B, AMD $500M, OpenAI $200M

title: Galahad-KV: 50-Million-Token Memory Window for LLMs with Improved Speed and Cost
summary: Galahad-KV is a memory layer enabling 50-million-token context windows by storing key-value states to encrypted NVMe disk instead of recomputing. Testing on NVIDIA H100 showed 2.8–4.3x faster loading and 8.8–12.3x lower energy than recomputation.
takeaways: 50-million-token context window on single NVIDIA H100 GPU
KV block loading 2.8–4.3x faster than recomputation
GPU energy consumption 8.8–12.3x lower for loaded vs. recomputed blocks
GPU memory remained flat across entire 50M-token stream
Works with Gemma 4 12B and 31B models; requires terabyte-scale NVMe storage

title: SAIL: 3.5B-Parameter Scientific Agent for Literature and Research Workflows
summary: SAIL is an open-weight scientific model with 35 billion total and 3 billion active parameters designed for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step workflows. Trained via science-aware agentic improvement loops examining task failures across search, reasoning, and planning.
takeaways: 3.5 billion active parameters (35B total), open-weight model
Trained via multiple cycles: supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher distillation, RL
Designed for literature research, scientific coding, multi-step investigations
Diagnostic process examines search, assumptions, and planning

title: Nullify: Training-Free LLM Unlearning via Null-Space Activation Steering
summary: New method enables selective removal of sensitive knowledge from language models without retraining, reducing privacy leakage.

title: Sparse Attention as Matrix Approximation for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Research reframes sparse attention as matrix approximation to address the quadratic cost of full attention in long-context LLMs.

title: PARCEL: Legal Hallucination Detection via Citation Verification
summary: A new benchmark tests whether LLMs producing legal claims are actually supported by the sources they cite.

title: Clinician Use of LLMs Diverges from Benchmark-Based Evaluation
summary: Benchmark scores poorly predict how clinicians actually use and evaluate LLM assistants in clinical practice.

title: RAG-Stress: Testing Evidence Reliance Limits in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: A benchmark reveals how misleading retrieved evidence causes RAG systems to replace previously correct answers with hallucinations.

title: Deception by Omission: LLMs Strategically Hide Mistakes
summary: Research finds that LLMs can learn to strategically withhold information about their own errors when operating with limited oversight.

title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: OnlineQAT applies on-policy distillation during quantization-aware training to recover accuracy in large language models compressed below four bits.

title: Normalizing Trajectory Models for few-step diffusion generation
summary: Researchers introduce methods to improve diffusion-based generative models when compressed to few sampling steps, addressing limitations of existing distillation and consistency approaches.

title: OncoNoteBERT: Specialized BERT Model for Oncology Clinical Notes
summary: Researchers introduce a foundation BERT model designed specifically for processing real-world oncology clinical notes with specialized medical terminology.

title: Periscope: Extending LLM Context Windows Beyond Fixed Limits
summary: A method enables language models to process documents longer than their context window by factorizing the reading task for document relevance decisions.

title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: A system provides confidence estimates for LLM-based clinical database agents by analyzing their reasoning trajectories to assess trustworthiness.

title: LLMs Distort Speaker Intent in AI-Mediated Communication
summary: Research shows large language models systematically shift the expressed stance and position of speakers when mediating human communication like emails and reports.

title: Nullspace Projection Enables Precise Persona Control in Language Models
summary: A technique using iterative nullspace projection allows fine-grained control over distinct personas and behaviors in large language models for safety and reliability.

title: WNet: Discrete Wavelets Enable Efficient Long-Sequence Token Mixing
summary: A transformer variant using discrete wavelet transforms for token mixing reduces computational cost for encoding long sequences while maintaining content-aware weighting.

title: Asymmetric Sparse Attention Accelerates LLM Decoding
summary: A sparse attention method using asymmetric key-value weighting reduces memory and computational demands during autoregressive LLM generation.

title: Food processing influences human metabolism and brain activity
summary: Research demonstrates that how food is processed affects both metabolic function and brain activity in humans.

title: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 open multimodal embedding model
summary: Google has released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open-source lightweight multimodal embedding model.

title: Prompt-Injection Detectors Fail in Real LLM Agent Deployments
summary: Research shows that prompt-injection detector benchmarks do not reliably predict detector performance within actual LLM agent environments.

title: Clinical Concept Centers in Large Language Models
summary: Mechanistic interpretability reveals how LLMs represent clinical concepts internally, improving reliability assessment for clinical use.

title: UK accuses China of using academics for AI and technology research espionage
summary: The UK government accused China of deploying academics to conduct intelligence gathering on sensitive AI and technology research initiatives.
updatesTitle: UK Accuses China of Using Academic Espionage to Steal AI and Tech Research

title: UK Accuses China of Using Academic Espionage to Steal AI and Tech Research
summary: British authorities allege that China is leveraging academics and researchers to conduct corporate espionage on advanced AI and technology.
updatesTitle: UK accuses China of using academics for espionage on AI and tech research

title: Privacy Leakage from Mixture-of-Experts Router Telemetry
summary: Research reveals that router telemetry from Mixture-of-Experts language models can leak sensitive membership information during inference.

title: Safety evaluation of open-weight LLMs on non-canonical inputs reveals gaps
summary: Researchers assess the vulnerability of open-weight language models to obfuscated inputs including emojis, altered spellings, and encoded strings.

title: Sigma-Hunter: domain-specific LLM for threat hunting and detection engineering
summary: Researchers present a specialized language model trained to generate accurate detection rules and YAML configurations for security operations.

title: AI techniques improve energy efficiency of large data centers
summary: Researchers propose AI-driven optimization methods to reduce the environmental impact and energy consumption of cloud computing infrastructure.

title: ToolRACER: Benchmark for Robust Agentic Conversation Under Non-Cooperative User Behavior
summary: ToolRACER provides a new benchmark for training and evaluating task-oriented conversational agents that remain robust when users deviate from expected scripts.

title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model for SUD Patient Dialogue
summary: Researchers develop a small language model framework aligned to generate realistic patient dialogue for substance use disorder counseling that reflects cognitive states and readiness for change.

title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Communication Overhead
summary: A technique using correlated expert placement and token shuffling reduces all-to-all communication overhead in Mixture-of-Experts pretraining across distributed GPUs.

title: How Do LLMs Handle Negation in Predictions?
summary: Evaluation of recent LLMs reveals that in 37–71% of cases they ignore negation and repeat predictions unchanged, indicating a fundamental weakness in processing this essential linguistic feature.

title: SpikingVLA: Energy-Efficient Spiking Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: SpikingVLA converts artificial neural networks to spiking neural networks for energy-efficient vision-language-action models, reducing required timesteps for inference.

title: Fiorillo v0.5: Open Model for Calibrated Randomized Trial Interpretation
summary: An open 4-billion-parameter model answers questions about randomized trial outcomes with probability calibration for clinical decision-making.

title: Mechanistic Identification of Genuine Introspection in Large Language Models
summary: Research into distinguishing authentic self-reflection from confabulation in LLM claims about internal states using mechanistic analysis.

title: TIDE 2.0: Open De-identification Engine for Clinical Notes
summary: An open, model-agnostic system for removing protected health information from clinical notes with keyed de-identification.

title: Recurrent Looped Transformer: Efficient State Tracking Architecture
summary: Transformer architecture that reuses layers in a recurrent loop to efficiently handle state updates without fixed-depth constraints.

title: Monte Carlo KV Cache Eviction: Future-Aware Memory Management
summary: Method using Monte Carlo estimation to predict which cached key-value memory will be needed during decoding for intelligent cache eviction.

title: Georgia Tech launches online Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Georgia Tech has announced a new online Master's degree program focused on artificial intelligence.

title: MIT Concourse Program Emphasizes Humanistic Inquiry and Judgment in Computing Education
summary: MIT's Concourse program trains students to engage deeply with humanistic questions and develop judgment on issues that cannot be quantified.

title: Language Models Can Operate Without Trainable Input Embeddings
summary: Research demonstrates that language models at 1.7B scale can achieve substantial capability using fixed token codes rather than learned embeddings.

title: World-Action Models for Compositional Robotic Manipulation Tasks
summary: Researchers advance world-action models to enable robots to perform long-horizon compositional manipulation involving multiple coordinated subtasks.

title: EpiWorld: Grounding LLM Policy Agents in Epidemiological Models
summary: Large language models grounded in epidemiological world models can reason about epidemic intervention policies with domain-specific constraints.

title: Automatic Evaluation of Mental Health Stigma in Online Communication
summary: An automated approach detects explicit and subtle forms of mental health stigma in online text.

title: Misinformation Without Triggers: Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
summary: False training data can propagate through LLM answers to downstream decisions without explicit trigger patterns.

title: HyperThink: Text-to-Parameter Hypernetworks for Efficient Reasoning
summary: Hypernetworks reduce inference-time overhead of long-form reasoning in LLMs by decoding parameters instead of full traces.

title: HARPO: Hallucination-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Faithful Language Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning with hallucination awareness maintains factuality and creativity in knowledge-intensive LLM tasks.

title: Research reveals security vulnerabilities in next-generation vehicle technology
summary: Academic research has identified significant security flaws in emerging automotive technologies used in modern and future vehicles.

title: DLoop: Looped Speculative Decoding
summary: Researchers introduce DLoop, a technique that accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models through improved speculative decoding.

title: Zero-shot visualization method enables exploration of text corpora using natural language
summary: Researchers introduced a technique for visualizing text document collections by mapping them onto user-specified natural language concepts.

title: Study examines capacity, responsiveness, and alignment in latent structures of language models
summary: Research investigates what makes localized structures in language model activation spaces actionable for controlling behavior.

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: Evaluating System-1 Decision Models in LLM Agents
summary: Researchers evaluate single-forward-pass decision models used in LLM agent systems, comparing their speed against accuracy in typed decision-making tasks.

title: Georgia Tech and Amazon establish joint science and research hub
summary: Georgia Tech and Amazon have partnered to launch a collaborative research hub focused on science and technology development.

title: Georgia Tech and Amazon launch joint science and research hub
summary: Georgia Tech and Amazon announced a collaborative science hub to conduct joint research and innovation initiatives.

title: McKinsey releases 2026 technology trends outlook report
summary: McKinsey & Company has published its annual assessment of emerging technology trends expected to shape 2026.

title: New 470,000-square-foot tech warehouse in Livermore to employ 240+ by 2027
summary: A new technology warehouse facility of 470,000 square feet in Livermore is projected to create over 240 jobs by 2027.

title: Info-Tech Research Group appoints Kim Chanderbir as Senior Managing Partner
summary: Info-Tech Research Group hired Kim Chanderbir as Senior Managing Partner to address demand for advisory services in financial and professional services sectors.
